query: RAP 这篇论文的核心贡献是什么？
answer: RAP 提出了一个新的 LLM 推理框架，把 LLM 同时重新用作世界模型和推理智能体，并结合基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的原则性规划算法。
support_quote: we propose a new LLM reasoning framework, Reasoning via Planning (RAP). RAP repurposes the LLM as both a world model and a reasoning agent
title: Reasoning with Language Model is Planning with World Model

query: RAP 是如何把推理过程形式化为马尔可夫决策过程的？
answer: RAP 把推理过程描述为马尔可夫决策过程：给定当前状态，LLM 作为推理智能体从生成分布中采样动作，再由世界模型预测下一状态。
support_quote: With the definition of state and action, the reasoning process can thus be described as a Markov decision process (MDP)
title: Reasoning with Language Model is Planning with World Model

query: RAP 在实验中主要使用哪个基础模型以及什么采样温度？
answer: RAP 及其基线默认使用 LLaMA-33B 作为基础 LLM，采样温度为 0.8。
support_quote: By default, we use the LLaMA-33B model (Touvron et al., 2023a) as the base LLM for both our methods and baselines, with a sampling temperature of 0.8.
title: Reasoning with Language Model is Planning with World Model

query: RAP 在 GSM8k 上的准确率结果如何？
answer: RAP(1) 达到 40.0% 准确率，RAP(10) 达到 48.6%，加上聚合后进一步提升到 51.6%。
support_quote: RAP(1) 40.0 RAP(10) 48.6 + aggr 51.6 Table 2: Results on GSM8k.
title: Reasoning with Language Model is Planning with World Model

query: RAP 这篇论文提到的主要局限是什么？
answer: 该工作主要使用冻结的 LLM，其能力可能受预训练限制；未来值得探索微调 LLM 以及结合外部工具。
support_quote: In this work, we mainly focus on utilizing frozen LLMs, whose abilities might be bounded by the pre-training.
title: Reasoning with Language Model is Planning with World Model
